decision.explanation: Documents d00, d01, and d02 describe Juho Pekka Niemi (born Yliniemi, 1909–1993) as a Finnish cross-country skier with Olympic and World Championship medals, while simultaneously containing contradictory text labeling him as an ice hockey player with identical biographical details (birth/death dates, 1936 Olympics); this suggests a data error conflating two different athletes or a single person with dual careers, but the text explicitly asserts both sports for the same name. Document d04 describes a different individual, Pekka Kalevi Niemi (born 1952), who is a weightlifter, confirming that 'Pekka Niemi' refers to multiple people in different eras and sports.
